ghada-jemimi.biography: Head of Legal and HR Departments specializing in employment law compliance, HR governance, internal policies and regulations, and organizational development. Holds a Master's degree in Digital Law and is a licensed Labor Consultant by the Saudi Ministry of Human Resources and Social Development. Brings extensive experience in legal affairs and human capital management, helping organizations build compliant, efficient, and people-focused workplaces while supporting sustainable business growth.

greeshma.biography: Finance & Accounting Professional with an MBA in Finance and over 15 years of experience in finance and accounting, with strong expertise in financial reporting, taxation, internal audit, and end-to-end accounting operations. Experienced in UAE VAT and Corporate Tax, audit coordination, financial analysis, internal controls, and management reporting, with a strong understanding of regulatory and compliance requirements. Dedicated and detail-oriented, committed to maintaining financial accuracy, strengthening controls, and delivering reliable financial insights to support business objectives.

camil-abdullah.biography: Seasoned Accounting Director & Finance Professional with 26 years of proven experience leading financial operations, accounting, and audit functions across complex business environments. Specialized in financial management, internal controls, audit processes, and financial reporting. Holds a Bachelor's degree in Business Administration with a major in Audit. Fluent in English, Arabic, and French.

metwally-el-sherbini.biography: Audit, Finance & Accounting Professional with 18 years of experience and a BSc in Accounting. Founding member at Bottom Line Co. since its inception in Jeddah, now managing the Riyadh branch with a dedicated team, bringing over 10 years of combined experience supporting clients to scale their businesses. Former Group Senior Internal Auditor at one of Saudi Arabia's largest companies (SAR 10B+ in annual revenue) for over 8 years, auditing all departments and diverse business lines with full exposure to operations, risk, and finance. Core expertise includes building financial systems from scratch per IFRS, ZATCA compliance, taxation in KSA, audit recommendations, risk assessment, budgeting, cash flow, financial analysis, and ERP implementation.

tima-zaarour.biography: Business Development Professional with nearly 8 years of experience driving client growth and strategic partnerships across Saudi Arabia and the wider region. Expertise spans client relationship management, financial acumen, and a results-driven approach to business growth, supporting clients across KSA, Lebanon, and the UAE with tailored back-office solutions. Holds a Master's degree in Business Management and is fluent in Arabic, English, and French.

ahmed-hussein.biography: Over 13 years of experience in accounting, auditing, and financial consultancy, including nine years as a Senior Accountant and four years in audit and financial advisory. Holds a Bachelor's degree in Accounting, with extensive experience across various accounting and ERP systems used in Saudi Arabia. Expertise spans financial reporting, internal controls, financial analysis, and audit procedures, with a strong focus on accuracy, compliance, and delivering practical financial insights.

lina-al-qarni.biography: SHRM Advanced Certified HR Executive & Operations Professional with 4 years of experience in end-to-end HR operations in Saudi Arabia. Experienced in employee lifecycle, payroll, recruitment, attendance, medical insurance, and government platforms. Skilled in Saudi Labor Law compliance and optimizing HR processes to support business operations, with strong knowledge of modern HR practices and employee relations

hisham-hassan.biography: External Auditor with 29 years of experience. Leads external audit engagements across various sectors, ensuring compliance and high-quality financial reporting. Prepares and analyzes financial statements, identifies risks, and enhances the accuracy of financial data. Evaluates internal controls, assesses compliance, and recommends improvements to strengthen financial governance. Provides zakat and tax consulting services, including return preparation, issue resolution, and regulatory guidance.

mohammed-ahmed.biography: Senior Financial Expert with over 18 years of experience specializing in statutory and internal auditing, tax and financial consulting, and strategic financial planning across diverse business sectors. Brings a deep understanding of international accounting standards, helping businesses reduce financial risk, strengthen internal controls, and streamline financial reporting. Committed to delivering precise, high-impact reports and advisory services that maintain fiscal integrity while fostering sustainable corporate growth.

mohamed-gamal.biography: Senior Internal Auditor with over 12 years of experience. Leads risk-based internal audits, evaluating financial controls, compliance, and operational effectiveness. Reviews financial statements, reporting cycles, and key account reconciliations, ensuring accuracy and integrity. Identifies control gaps, financial risks, and process inefficiencies, delivering actionable recommendations. Oversees VAT, WHT, Zakat, Transfer Pricing, and ZATCA compliance. Drives improvements in internal controls, accounting policies, procedures, and financial processes. Delivers financial analysis, budgeting, cash-flow forecasting, and management reporting. Manages multiple audit engagements and coordinates with senior management, external auditors, and tax advisors. Has led audit and financial reviews for 25+ clients across diverse industries.

jad-haddad.biography: Audit Manager & Financial Executive with over 24 years of professional experience in auditing, accounting, and financial consulting, including 14 years in audit and financial advisory and 10 years in senior financial and management positions. Holds a Bachelor's degree in Accounting, with extensive experience leading and executing audit engagements, reviewing financial statements and reports, evaluating internal control systems, identifying and assessing risks, analyzing financial performance, and ensuring compliance with relevant financial and accounting policies, standards, and regulations. Also experienced in preparing financial reports, reviewing budgets, cash flow forecasting, and financial analysis. Solid experience with Zakat and tax requirements in Saudi Arabia, including Value Added Tax, Withholding Tax, Zakat, and Zakat, Tax and Customs Authority (ZATCA) requirements, along with extensive experience in accounting systems and software.

khodr-makke.biography: Finance & Audit Professional with an MBA and over 25 years of experience in finance and audit. Brings strong financial leadership and expertise in audit, internal controls, IFRS reporting, feasibility studies, and business valuation, supporting informed financial decisions and stronger business performance.

lama-mohammad.biography: 3+ years of experience in HR operations, employee relations, and Saudi Labor Law. Holds a Master's degree in Entrepreneurship and Creativity and a Bachelor's degree in Law, bringing together HR, legal, and business expertise to support organisational growth and effective HR practices.

manar-alsobhi.biography: Licensed and MHRSD-certified, with 10+ years of experience in organizational and administrative development. Specializes in drafting ironclad employment contracts, resolving complex labor localization (Nitaqat) challenges, and managing government relations — overseeing the full contract lifecycle from renewals to final settlements.

hisham-youssef.position: Senior Internal Auditor, Financial Analyst & Tax Consultant
hisham-youssef.biography: Senior Internal Auditor, Financial Analyst & Tax Consultant with over 14 years of experience in internal audit, financial analysis, and tax consultancy. Proven expertise in leading risk-based audits, evaluating financial and operational controls, reviewing financial statements and reconciliations, and identifying control gaps, financial risks, and process inefficiencies. Experienced in VAT, withholding tax, Zakat, transfer pricing, and ZATCA compliance, as well as budgeting, cash-flow forecasting, and management reporting. Successfully led audit and financial reviews for more than 25 clients across diverse industries while coordinating closely with senior management, external auditors, and tax advisors. Recognized for delivering practical recommendations that strengthen governance, enhance financial accuracy, and improve operational efficiency.

sally-maalouf.biography: Operations, Finance & Administration Professional with a BS in Banking and Finance from AUST and around 8 years of experience across the banking sector (HR, back office, operations, and treasury), as well as management, training, sales, development, and portfolio management. Currently manages daily client financial transactions, office operations, and banking activities, including payment reconciliation, cash flow monitoring, and financial and operational reporting. Handles client invoicing, supplier payments, payroll support, and employee attendance records, while supporting general HR and day-to-day operational activities to ensure smooth business operations.

nicole-mhanna.biography: Accounting & Audit Professional with 3 years of experience in the field. Areas of expertise include financial accounting, audit procedures, financial reporting, account reconciliations, and financial data analysis. Dedicated to maintaining accuracy and compliance while contributing to efficient and well-structured financial processes.

carelle-abdallah.biography: Accounting Professional with 2 years of experience. Areas of expertise include financial transaction processing, bank reconciliations, financial management reports, and maintaining accurate financial records. Experience also includes supporting day-to-day accounting operations and ensuring financial documentation is properly organized and recorded. Fluent in Arabic, English, and French.

elias-youssef.biography: Junior Accountant completing a degree in Business Management, with 3 years of experience in recording transactions, account reconciliation, financial reporting, and document management. Previous experience in cash handling, payment tracking, and operations coordination complements his accounting skills.
